entities.summary: Vladyslav Sendecki, known as Vladislav Sendecki, is a Polish jazz pianist. In Polish, his name is spelled Władysław Sendecki. Since 1996 he has been permanently associated with the NDR Big Band as a composer and pianist. Sendecki is one of the top five pianists in the world according to the New York Village Voice. Vladislav Sendecki was a composers & musicians from Gorlice (b. 1955, Gorlice). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
